dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: One prominent, thin white horizontal band is visible across the greater coverts, showing high contrast against dark gray/black feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A small, irregular white patch is visible on the posterior neck at the base of the black crown.

other_distinctive_markers: Large, high-contrast white cheek patch (auricular region) bordered by black plumage on the head and throat.
